snippet.title: Lil Gator Game - In the Dark DLC Release Window Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/product/EP1053-PPSA17455_00-0099906695056532

Lil Gator's biggest journey yet is on the horizon. Cave in to the fun when Lil Gator Game: In the Dark DLC launches in early 2026!

Lil Gator Game: In the Dark DLC doubles the size of the original game, introducing a massive underground world full of hidden nooks, secret treasures, and plenty of new pals to meet. Cozy cave tunnels glow with lightsticks, mysterious caverns hide surprises, and every crevasse has a new friend waiting to help out on your adventure.

The fun awaits on PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4!

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #lilgatorgame
